title: The Nikolskii Constant in Arbitrary Dimension
summary: We study the radial extremal function $\varphi(|{\,\cdot\,}|)$ arising in the problem of finding the sharp Nikolskii constant $\mathcal C_d$ in $\mathit{PW}_1^1(\mathbb R^d)$ for arbitrary dimension $d\ge1$. We prove a factorization $\varphi=Φ_1Φ_2$, where $Φ_1$ and $Φ_2$ are entire functions of exponential type $1/2$ satisfying a functional equation and second-order differential equations with polynomial coefficients.
